title: ObjectState
description: One detected object inside a PerceptionFrame from Person 1. Planner validates each object against this schema before processing.

object_id.description: Unique object identifier for this frame

class_id.description: Detected object class — must match a known bin mapping

confidence.description: Detection confidence score from Person 1 (0.0–1.0). Objects below 0.75 are rejected.

pose_base.description: Object pose in robot base frame — already transformed by Person 1

position_m.description: [x, y, z] in meters, robot base frame

quaternion_xyzw.description: [x, y, z, w] — must be unit quaternion

grasp_hint.description: Suggested gripper approach from Person 1's shape analysis

failure_reason.description: Set by Person 1 if detection had issues. Null means clean detection.
